properties.markdownProperty:
Textual description of the classes of the static model, of their attributes, of their associations and of their constraints. Each element must be traced to the information requirements and business rules it comes from (*Dependencies* property, which is shown in a **Traceability matrix** and not in the table of the object).
Recommended archetypes: **Entity class** with its **Attributes**, **Enumeration** with its **Enumeration values**, **Association** with its **Roles** and **Constraint**.
